source: Verified research, Augment Auggie 1.2.2 ([Auggie] rows of the Zed/Aider/Goose/Droid/Auggie/Junie entry): docs.augmentcode.com/cli/hooks and the npm package read on this host (skeptic: hook_pre_tool, hook_session_start and hook_stop confirmed).

selection.sniffNote: Auggie's payload is Claude-shaped and its deny is the claude bytes, so no sniff is needed; the skeptic lists AUGMENT_PROJECT_DIR among the hook env vars.

deny.source: Auggie hook_payload_example: exit 0 plus hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision deny; only deny is supported.

context.source: [Auggie] hook_session_start: SessionStart runs in the background and its output is not added to agent context, so lessons go to a rules file (plan PR 11).

PostToolUse.source: [Auggie] hook_post_tool: PostToolUse receives tool_output, tool_error, tool_result, tool_is_error and file_changes

UserPromptSubmit.source: [Auggie] hook_user_prompt: the event is PromptSubmit and its payload field is user_prompt

SessionStart.source: [Auggie] hook_session_start: SessionStart exists (background); its input keys beyond the common ones are not documented

SessionEnd.source: Not in the [Auggie] rows of the verified research; the common keys only

Stop.source: [Auggie] hook_stop: the Stop event exists, payload agent_stop_cause; it runs in the background and cannot block
